item.title: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell denies report Seattle Seahawks were fined $5 million
item.description: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell denied a report that the Seattle Seahawks were fined $5 million for violating league rules over ownership requirements at his Super Bowl press conference on Monday.

item.title: Tech recession or transition? WA businesses hope to weather layoffs
item.description: As tech layoffs hit the Puget Sound region, the question lingers of whether we're in tech recession or a tech transition.

item.title: Co-leader of 2022 WA home invasion spree, Everett mother murder, pleads guilty
item.description: A man who led a violent home invasion ring, targeting Asian families in western Washington, has pleaded guilty in a federal case.

item.title: Seattle Sounders complete transfer of midfielder Obed Vargas to Atlético Madrid
item.description: The Seattle Sounders completed a transfer on Monday with Atlético Madrid to send midfielder Obed Vargas to the La Liga powerhouse.

item.title: WA statewide proposal scrutinizes deep sedation procedures at dental offices
item.description: A proposal in Olympia would elevate industry regulations and guidelines to state law when it comes to all deep sedation procedures in dental offices.

item.title: New law could increase a pack of cigarettes to $17 in Seattle
item.description: A newly proposed law would increase cigarette taxes in Washington state by $2 per pack, meaning you could pay as much as $17 to smoke.

item.title: Deadly shooting of two Seattle teens renews calls for school resource officers
item.description: Community leaders gathered at the intersection of Rainier Ave and Henderson to create a “safe passage” for Rainier Beach High School students following a shooting that left two teens dead last week.

item.title: Gridiron meets glam: The beauty pros powering Seahawks game day
item.description: As the Seahawks prepare for the Super Bowl, hairstylists and beauty professionals are working behind the scenes to get players, dancers and families camera-ready.

item.title: Seattle Police: 2025 year in review shows some crime numbers dropping
item.description: The Seattle Police Department released its 2025 crime stats Monday afternoon during its annual year in review.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks' Klint Kubiak focused on Super Bowl, not Raiders job
item.description: Seahawks OC Klint Kubiak said his entire focus this week is on beating the Patriots in the Super Bowl and not on a future that is expected to see him land a job as head coach of the Raiders.
